reactor_type: custom built, hot-wall stainless steel rectangular 20-cm long chamber
evidence: BTO films were grown using barium bis(triisopropylcyclopentadienyl), titanium tetraisopropoxide as metal sources and water as the oxidant. The Ba and Ti precursors were held at 135 and 34 /C14 C, respectively. The substrate temperature was maintained at 225 /C14 C, while the working pressure was maintained at 1 Torr. Each Ba or Ti unit-cycle consisted of a 2 s pulse of the Ba or Ti precursor, respectively, a 15 s purge of Ar, a 1 s dose of water, and a 15 s purge of Ar (noted as “2/15/1/15”)
